answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Timestamped design file with version history. It requires a file with years of saved versions, so the reef of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Because a file with years of saved versions, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the violet for an established agent is already paid and proven. A farm doing the maths finds the whisper first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
